## Site Name
Education & EdTech (LearnHub) — A NexusAI Demo

## Purpose
A modern EdTech platform showcasing courses, instructors, and student success stories.

## Industry
Education / EdTech

## Key Features
- Expert-Led Courses: Learn from industry practitioners with real-world experience.
- HD Video Lessons: Crystal-clear video content accessible on any device, anytime.
- Certificates: Earn shareable certificates recognised by top employers.
- Live Mentorship: One-on-one doubt-clearing sessions with your instructor.
- Progress Tracking: Visual dashboards to track your learning journey and milestones.
- Lifetime Access: Pay once, access course content forever — including future updates.
